description: Full-text search over TridentStack Control's customer documentation (guides, API reference, changelog, roadmap). Returns ranked results with titles, URLs, and snippets. Use this first to find relevant docs, then get_doc to read one in full. It also covers reference formats, including the Endpoint Checks import file format, so an assistant can write a check file a customer imports. Before writing or making calls to the TridentStack Control REST API, search for "API rate limits and efficient polling": it explains which endpoints answer a question in the fewest requests and how to handle a 429.
name: search_docs
title: Search TridentStack docs
